title: Mathematical Thinking
standfirst: Proof, abstraction, and mathematical writing — the habits of mind behind the rest of the mathematics curriculum.
instructor: Prof. Amritanshu Prasad & Prof. Sankaran Viswanath
resources_note: An IITM email may be required for some of the resources above; any other access request will be strictly rejected.

description_paragraphs: This course introduces the fundamentals of mathematical proof and problem-solving, facilitating the transition from basic methods to more advanced mathematical concepts and reasoning.
faculty: Prof. Amritanshu Prasad, The Institute of Mathematical Science
Prof. Sankaran Viswanath, The Institute of Mathematical Science

weeks_text.label: Week 1
weeks_text.text: Foundations of mathematics; Sequences and summations (sigma notation); Set theory; Cardinality and bijections; Natural numbers and integers.

weeks_text.label: Week 2
weeks_text.text: Infinite sets and real numbers; Cantor's diagonalization; Ordered fields and completeness; Least upper bound property; Mathematical logic.

weeks_text.label: Week 3
weeks_text.text: Number theory basics; Divisibility and GCD; Euclidean algorithm and its proof.

weeks_text.label: Week 4
weeks_text.text: Prime numbers and modular arithmetic; Fermat's Little Theorem; Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic; Inclusion-exclusion principle.

weeks_text.label: Week 5
weeks_text.text: Combinatorial principles; Pigeonhole principle; Sieve of Eratosthenes; Distribution and gaps of primes.

weeks_text.label: Week 6
weeks_text.text: Combinatorics fundamentals; Binomial coefficients and theorem; Permutations; Lattice paths; Random sampling.

weeks_text.label: Week 7
weeks_text.text: Graph theory basics; Connectivity and distance; Trees and adjacency matrices; Graph coloring; Sperner's lemma.

weeks_text.label: Week 8
weeks_text.text: Limits and continuity; Properties of limits; Sequential continuity; Intermediate Value Theorem.

weeks_text.label: Week 9
weeks_text.text: Advanced limits; Fibonacci sequence behavior; Sandwich and shifting lemmas.

weeks_text.label: Week 10
weeks_text.text: Differential calculus; Derivatives; Higher-order derivatives (Faà di Bruno's formula).

weeks_text.label: Week 11
weeks_text.text: Integral calculus; Riemann integrals; Mean Value Theorem.

weeks_text.label: Week 12
weeks_text.text: Uniform continuity; Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.
